attribution.note: Marcus directly asserts and endorses the assessment in his own discussion.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the present-tense assessment and domestic humanoid application. The surrounding hypothetical grants working motor skills; it is not a future prediction.

contract.note: Practical safety and competence across ordinary household situations is a fair plain reading. Viability requires interpretation because Marcus supplies no performance or safety threshold. The contract appropriately holds motor competence fixed.

evidence.note: The dated company report demonstrates limited household planning capabilities and failures in August 2022. It does not establish general household safety or settle the October snapshot.
The September preprint demonstrates useful LLM-generated robot policies. These capabilities do not establish safe, adequate general household decision-making at the target date.
DeepMind's May report describes its own proof-of-concept system and lack of deployment. This does not establish demonstrated unsafety or the absence of all viable options in October.

reviews.rationale: The packet documents promising but limited earlier systems. It neither establishes a viable general household controller on October 16 nor establishes that all available options were inadequate and unsafe. AlphaStar's suitability and safety are untested here, and missing demonstrations cannot prove the claim.
